top_moves.title: Grok 4.7 launches today — 2.1T params, trained on SpaceX engineering data
top_moves.body: xAI's Grok 4.7 hits its targeted Sept 12 release, expanding the SpaceX-engineering-data training angle first flagged last week. Enterprise Grok Bot access/audit controls and a Cursor Enterprise trial ship alongside it.

top_moves.title: Anthropic ships broad Claude Code update: plugin evals, output-style switching, Enterprise Smart Reports
top_moves.body: New `claude plugin eval` command scores plugin eval suites with reproducible results; `/output-style` switches chat voice on the fly. Enterprise gets beta Smart Reports (usage/cost/friction analysis) and the Admin API's user-management endpoints (members, invites, groups, custom roles) are now out of beta.

top_moves.title: OpenAI ships ChatGPT Images 2.5 and Voice/Codex upgrades
top_moves.body: Images 2.5 adds templates, mobile sketch-to-image, and full-screen editing with comments. ChatGPT Voice can now route through GPT-6 Astra for harder reasoning, and Codex adds Apple Messages support and read-only chat sharing.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6 Astra rolling out broadly; ChatGPT Images 2.5 and Voice/Codex upgrades ship.
providers.detail: GPT-6 Astra (72.6% on OSWorld 2.0, ~40 min/task) is expanding from limited orgs to all Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise users and the API. ChatGPT Images 2.5 brings templates, sketch-to-image, and full-screen editing; Voice can now use GPT-6 Astra for search and hard reasoning; Codex adds Apple Messages support and read-only chat sharing.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Claude Code gets plugin evals + output-style switching; Enterprise Smart Reports beta; Admin API user-management out of beta.
providers.detail: A broad Claude Code release adds `claude plugin eval` for scored, reproducible plugin testing and `/output-style` to list/switch output styles, plus reliability and prompt-cache fixes across CLI, VS Code, web, and Slack. Enterprise gets beta Smart Reports analyzing team usage, cost, and friction. The Sonnet 5 pricing lock ($2/$10 per MTok, no Sept 1 increase) continues to hold.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini Advanced adds multi-file code upload for debugging/review workflows.
providers.detail: Users can now upload multiple code files at once to get help understanding, modifying, or debugging code in Gemini Advanced. No new flagship model news today beyond the Gemini 3.8 Flash rollout already flagged last week; Gemini Omni Flash (video gen/editing) continues rolling out to GA.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 (2.1T, SpaceX-trained) launches today, Sept 12.
providers.detail: Musk's Sept 2 '10 days out' post lands on schedule. Grok 4.7 continues xAI's chatbot-to-workbench expansion — enterprise Grok Bot access/network/audit controls, a 2-week free Grok + Cursor Enterprise trial, and Grok 4.5's coding strengths (debugging, refactoring, multi-file edits) carry forward.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new headline today.
providers.detail: Muse Spark 1.3 (Sept 2, agentic-workflow update with ~20% fewer tool calls) and Muse Code beta exit stand. Meta's shift from open-weight Llama to the closed-source Muse line continues; no undated open-weights release has materialized.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: No new headline, fourth straight quiet day.
providers.detail: OCR 4.1 GA and the new Agentic Search retrieval layer stand. Leanstral 1.5 (Lean 4 formal-proof model) is on track to retire Sept 30, 2026.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: No new headline today.
providers.detail: August's Computer in Email and expanded model access (GPT-5.6 Terra/Luna, Grok 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning) continue rolling out; Model Council remains the standout differentiator for side-by-side model comparison.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot Cost Management gets new governance controls; reusable skills follow users across SharePoint/OneDrive.
providers.detail: Spending policies now auto-apply to newly released Copilot services/agents (admins can opt out); new threshold alerts and custom approval routing for credit requests. Reusable skills and their evaluations now travel with users across SharePoint and OneDrive rather than staying tied to one site.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Oct 2 model deprecation wave announced: Gemini 3.5/3.6 Flash → 3.8, Kimi K2.7 Code → K3, Claude Opus 4.7 → Opus 5.
providers.detail: Copilot app and CLI now honor content exclusions across agentic workflows, and the Copilot harness is GA in JetBrains. Claude Fable 5.1 is available to Pro+/Max/Business/Enterprise; Gemini 3.8 Flash is rolling out tenant-wide ahead of the deprecation cutover.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new headline today.
providers.detail: Self-hosted machines (tool execution stays on customer infrastructure, shipped Sept 2) stand as the latest release; no new announcement surfaced today.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: No release since June 12 — now 87 days quiet.
providers.detail: Notion page-to-Gamma transform remains the only recent interoperability feature. No indication of a near-term release.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: Workspace owners can now restrict which AI models Notion Agent and Custom Agents use (Sept 9).
providers.detail: Business/Enterprise plans get per-surface model allowlisting and a default model setting for Custom Agents. Standalone Notion Mail inbox (web/desktop/iOS) is winding down Sept 22; a new Developer section covers Workers, connections, and tokens.

persistent_signals.text: xAI — Grok 4.7 (2.1T, SpaceX-trained) rollout — 2 weeks running (flagged as 'still training' last week, launched today)
GitHub Copilot — model retirement/deprecation cadence — 2 weeks running (MAI-Code-1-Flash retired Sept 10, now Gemini/Kimi/Opus deprecations set for Oct 2)

month_themes.then: Open-weight model releases (Meta Muse Glimmer, 30B Apache 2.0), abrupt billing-model shifts (Notion Workers → Credits), and a cluster of hard API shutdown deadlines (Anthropic Prompt Tools, Google Gemini image models).
month_themes.now: Frontier-model launches accelerating in parallel (GPT-6 Astra, Grok 4.7 same week), developer-tooling maturity over raw model races (Claude Code plugin evals, GitHub Copilot governance/content controls), and AI governance frameworks solidifying (NIST SP 1353 draft, ISO 42001/NIST RMF crosswalks).

habits.shift: New `/output-style` command lets you draft the same runbook in a technical voice for IT staff and a plain-language voice for executive sign-off without rewriting from scratch.
NIST's SP 1353 draft (AI-assisted CSF analysis/reporting) is open for comment through Oct 15 — worth a pass now before it hardens into guidance clients will ask about.
A fresh 2.1T-parameter entrant launching today gives you another concrete benchmark point when clients ask how vendor AI capability claims stack up.
Astra's stronger, faster computer-use benchmark supports tighter technical scope language in SOWs involving AI-assisted work estimates.
Still 87 days without a release — no workflow change warranted; keep current deck process and don't wait on Gamma for new capability.
Voice mode can now route through GPT-6 Astra for harder reasoning mid-conversation, making it more viable for live client walkthroughs that hit unexpected questions.

habits.task: client advisory on AI data risk
habits.tool: Microsoft Copilot Cost Management + NIST SP 1353
habits.shift: New Copilot spend-governance controls plus the open NIST AI/CSF draft give fresh, citable material for advising clients on both AI cost and data-governance policy in the same conversation.

community.signal: Early discussion of the new `claude plugin eval` command and `/output-style` switching as workflow-changing rather than cosmetic.
community.so_what: Worth testing before next client engagement — output-style switching could cut deck/report reformatting time.

community.signal: Continued community concern over Meta's pivot from open-weight Llama to the closed Muse line, with no open-weights date in sight.
community.so_what: If local/on-prem model deployment matters for a client's data-residency posture, don't count on a new open Meta model near-term.

community.signal: Reaction to GPT-6 Astra's broad rollout and its 72.6% OSWorld 2.0 computer-use score, with skepticism about how the benchmark maps to real agentic tasks.
community.so_what: Treat Astra's computer-use claims as directional, not a guarantee, when scoping client automation work.

watch.title: GitHub Copilot model deprecation wave — Oct 2, 2026
watch.body: Gemini 3.5/3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Claude Opus 4.7 all retire from Copilot surfaces; confirm any client integrations pinned to these models have a migration path.

watch.title: Mistral Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30, 2026
watch.body: Formal-proof engineering model shutting down — low client relevance unless a formal-verification workflow depends on it.

watch.title: NIST SP 1353 comment period closes Oct 15, 2026
watch.body: Draft guide for using AI in CSF 2.0 analysis and reporting — comment window is open now; relevant to any client compliance advisory work referencing NIST frameworks.

watch.title: Notion standalone Mail inbox winds down Sept 22, 2026
watch.body: Web/desktop/iOS standalone inbox is being discontinued; flag for any client using it as a dependency.

watch.title: Grok 4.7 post-launch stability and enterprise rollout
watch.body: Watch for early stability reports and enterprise access rollout pace in the days following today's launch before recommending it in client-facing work.
